mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT target USING ( SELECT #{empId} AS EMP_ID, #{providerCd} AS PROVIDER_CD, #{emailAddr} AS EMAIL_ADDR, #{googleSubId} AS GOOGLE_SUB_ID, #{accessToken} AS ACCESS_TOKEN, #{refreshToken} AS REFRESH_TOKEN, #{tokenExprDt} AS TOKEN_EXPR_DT, #{scopeCn} AS SCOPE_CN, #{tokenStatusCd} AS TOKEN_STATUS_CD, #{useYn} AS USE_YN, #{connectedDt} AS CONNECTED_DT FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.EMP_ID = source.EMP_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.PROVIDER_CD = source.PROVIDER_CD, target.EMAIL_ADDR = source.EMAIL_ADDR, target.GOOGLE_SUB_ID = source.GOOGLE_SUB_ID, target.ACCESS_TOKEN = source.ACCESS_TOKEN, target.REFRESH_TOKEN = COALESCE(source.REFRESH_TOKEN, target.REFRESH_TOKEN), target.TOKEN_EXPR_DT = source.TOKEN_EXPR_DT, target.SCOPE_CN = source.SCOPE_CN, target.TOKEN_STATUS_CD = source.TOKEN_STATUS_CD, target.USE_YN = source.USE_YN, target.CONNECTED_DT = source.CONNECTED_DT, target.REVOKED_DT = NULL, target.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EMP_ID, PROVIDER_CD, EMAIL_ADDR, GOOGLE_SUB_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN, TOKEN_EXPR_DT, SCOPE_CN, TOKEN_STATUS_CD, USE_YN, CONNECTED_DT, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( source.EMP_ID, source.PROVIDER_CD, source.EMAIL_ADDR, source.GOOGLE_SUB_ID, source.ACCESS_TOKEN, source.REFRESH_TOKEN, source.TOKEN_EXPR_DT, source.SCOPE_CN, source.TOKEN_STATUS_CD, source.USE_YN, source.CONNECTED_DT, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PROVIDER_CD = 'GOOGLE' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND TOKEN_STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
